decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated 25 products, many of which were camping gear rather than actual backpacks. I narrowed my consideration set to five specialized backpacks: a tactical 35L survival pack (G4Free), a dedicated ice skate backpack (Transpack), two hydration packs (N NEVO RHINO and Mubasel), and an everyday carry (EDC) pack (Maxpedition). I ultimately chose the Maxpedition Prepared Citizen Classic v2.0. While it is one of the more expensive items at $72.57, its high 4.7 rating and focus on durability and 'nondescript' aesthetics make it a superior choice for a long-term EDC bag compared to the more niche hydration or sports-specific packs.
